data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate is proud to present this brand-new 2-bedroom apartment with a maid’s room in the highly sought-after area of Al Wasl, Dubai. Located in a premium neighborhood, this apartment offers the perfect combination of luxury, style, and convenience.

Property Features:

Brand new apartment
Balcony offering community views
Maid’s room for added convenience
Bright, spacious living areas
Covered parking for one vehicle
Amenities and Facilities:

Fully equipped fitness center to support an active lifestyle
Relaxing outdoor pool to unwind and enjoy
Beautifully landscaped garden area for peaceful walks
Trendy community lounge ideal for social gatherings and events
Secure children’s play area for young ones
24/7 security and concierge services for your peace of mind

Canal Front Residences stands as the epitome of luxury living in one of Dubai’s most desirable and dynamic locations. This exceptional property offers residents a perfect blend of elegance, modern design, comfort, and convenience. Enjoy breathtaking views, world-class amenities, and a prime location that brings the best of Dubai right to your doorstep. It’s the perfect place to call home.
